headline: 'Football brings us together!': Night of euphoria and tension in an electrified Paris after PSG wins Champions League
subhead: As many as 20,000 people gathered on the Champs-Elysées on Saturday to celebrate Paris Saint-Germain's victory over Arsenal (1-1, 4-3 on penalties). In the greater Paris area, 283 people were arrested by 1:30 am on Sunday following clashes with police.

subhead: Shelling was audible and smoke rose from the surrounding area as the invading army's banner was seen above the medieval Beaufort Castle, which Israeli forces famously used as a base during their previous two-decade-long occupation.

headline: Mexico's secret cooperation with the US on deportations exposed in new report
subhead: According to Human Rights Watch, 12,977 of the 18,453 people deported by the Trump administration up to March were transferred to Mexico, under an agreement never acknowledged by the government of Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum.

headline: Paul McCartney blends rock and melancholic ballads in 'The Boys of Dungeon Lane,' his 20th solo album
subhead: The Beatles' co-founder invited the band's drummer, Ringo Starr, for a duet on the album. Starr, meanwhile, released his own record in April.

headline: Antonin Baudry, the filmmaker liberating Charles de Gaulle
subhead: Baudry's new diptych 'De Gaulle' follows the leader of Free France during World War II. In his film, the former French diplomat aims to shake off the general's image as a rigid savior.

subhead: Committed to connecting different fields of knowledge to develop his 'complex thought,' this former member of the Resistance and deeply humanist intellectual advocated for a revolution of consciousness. He died in Paris on Friday, his wife confirmed to Le Monde.

headline: Who will manage to capture the 'middle' electorate Macron seized 10 years ago?
subhead: Among French President Emmanuel Macron's political heirs, and even on the left, some are starting to believe that the presidential campaign could play out in the middle, amid the collapse of France's former governing parties.

headline: Europe's heatwave in pictures, from Milan's Duomo to the crowded beaches of southern England
subhead: Europe is currently experiencing an unprecedented heatwave. From Italy to the United Kingdom, several countries have recorded temperatures far above seasonal norms, prompting some authorities to issue the highest-level health alerts.
